Method of Attack: Fake cryptocurrency giveaways impersonating celebrities and crypto exchanges
Scam websites prompting users to register and deposit cryptocurrency to activate accounts
Stealing deposited cryptocurrency and KYC information
Attack Vector: Fake giveaway videos on social media with deep fake celebrity endorsements
User registration and deposit prompts on scam websites
Indicators of Compromise: Fake crypto exchange domains: bitoxies.com, moonexio.com, altgetxio.com, cratopex.com
Requests for .005 Bitcoin deposits to activate accounts
Deep fake videos of Elon Musk
